controls.name: uniaxial_strain
controls.definition: Independently imposed uniaxial strain along the AC direction, expressed as fractional lattice change.

readouts.name: relative_permittivity_change
readouts.definition: Change in the real relative dielectric permittivity along the AC direction.

applicability.statement: Applies to the DFT Independent Particle Approximation elasto-optic response of SnS along the AC direction at photon energy 1.55 eV; the relation uses the reported local linear slope.
